name: govee-light-manager
description: Self-hosted web app for managing Govee outdoor lights through the official Govee API.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @glm/shared && npm run build -w @glm/server && npm run build -w @glm/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @glm/server" "npm run dev -w @glm/web"
scripts.dev:mock: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n mock,server,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run mock-govee -w @glm/server" "npm run dev:mock -w @glm/server" "npm run dev -w @glm/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
